Simulate stand trajectories under a silvicultural itinerary

Source: R/simuler_itineraire.R
simuler_itineraire.Rd

Runs a calibrated FINN model step by step from the initial state of each plot, and applies the rules of an itinerary between the steps by removing stems from the cohorts (spec 068, D-2): FINN learns the natural dynamics only, the cuts are imposed from outside.

Usage

simuler_itineraire(
  calibration,
  arbres,
  environnement,
  itineraire = NULL,
  horizon = 50,
  n_tirages = 20L,
  elargissement = c("racine", "lineaire"),
  volume = FALSE,
  unites = NULL,
  carbone = FALSE,
  bef = 1.3,
  fraction_carbone = 0.5
)

Arguments

calibration

A "finn_calibration" object from calibrer_finn(), with conformal residuals from conformer_finn() for an interval.

arbres

data.frame of the initial trees: placette, essence, d1 (cm), poids (stems/ha); with a statut column, only "vivant" and "mort" rows are kept, as in predire_finn().

environnement

data.frame, one row per plot: placette and the variables of the calibration. Held constant over the horizon.

itineraire

NULL (no management) or one entry of itineraires_catalogue() with statut_source = "source". Rules used (regles), all optional except the rotation:

rotation_ans

years between two interventions; a multiple of calibration$pas_annees.

diametre_exploitabilite_cm

every stem at or above this diameter is harvested.

surface_terriere_cible_m2ha

if the basal area is above the target, a share (G - cible) / G of the stems of every cohort is removed (thinning across all sizes).

intensite_prelevement_pct

maximum share of the stems removed by the thinning; alone (no target), the share removed at every intervention.

norme_g_selon_dg

a thinning norm by quadratic mean diameter: dg_cm (increasing) and g_m2ha, the basal area left after thinning at that mean diameter. The target is interpolated on the plot's Dg (all stems); below the first dg_cm there is no thinning, beyond the last one its value holds. Replaces surface_terriere_cible_m2ha (not both).

Stems removed are drawn (binomial per cohort): rounding would never cut a cohort of a single large stem.

horizon

Numeric. Years simulated, a multiple of calibration$pas_annees. Default 50.

n_tirages

Integer. Trajectories per plot (FINN is stochastic). Default 20.

elargissement

Character. How the conformal half-width q (measured for one step) grows with the number of steps k: "racine" (default, q * sqrt(k), independent errors from step to step) or "lineaire" (q * k, errors that add up). Both are hypotheses: no plot is revisited over 50 years.

volume

Logical. Also compute the merchantable volume ("volume" and "volume_preleve", m3/ha) with the one-entry Schaeffer tariffs of the IFN (ifn_tarif_schaeffer_reference(): number and advised type of each species, cascade SER -> GRECO -> France with the SER of the ser column of environnement when present). Stems below 7.5 cm (the IFN threshold) have no volume. The "other" group takes the tariff of the dominant "other" species (basal area) of the plot at the start that has a tariff, or of all plots. Default FALSE.

unites

data.frame or NULL. placette, unite: the plots of each management unit (UGF). The output is then one row per unit, the mean of its plots (equal weights), with the half-width of a unit of k plots measured by conformer_finn() on groups of k held-out plots.

carbone

Logical. Also compute the carbon of the merchantable stem wood ("carbone" and "carbone_preleve", tC/ha): the volume of the same tariffs as volume (needed, computed even when volume = FALSE) times the basic wood density of the species (infradensite_espar(), that of the tariff species for "other"), bef and fraction_carbone. Default FALSE.

bef

Numeric. Biomass expansion factor from stem volume to total aboveground biomass. Default 1.30, as indicateur_c1_biomasse().

fraction_carbone

Numeric. Carbon fraction of the dry biomass. Default 0.50, the value of inst/extdata/wood_density.csv used by indicateur_c1_biomasse().

Value

data.frame in long format, one row per plot, year and variable: placette, itineraire, annee (years from the start, 0 = initial state), variable ("g": basal area before the cut, m2/ha; "tiges": stems/ha before the cut; "g_prelevee": basal area removed at that date, m2/ha; with volume = TRUE, "volume" and "volume_preleve", m3/ha; with carbone = TRUE, "carbone" and "carbone_preleve", tC/ha), moyenne (mean of the trajectories), bas, haut (interval, for "g" only) and intervalle ("conforme" at one step, "conforme_racine" or "conforme_lineaire" beyond, "aucun" without conformal residuals or at year 0). With unites: unite instead of placette, plus n_placettes and groupes_conformes ("voisins", "hasard" or "placette" for a unit of one plot).

Details

The climate is the one of environnement, held constant: without an explicit scenario a 50-year trajectory assumes the recent climate. The response of the stand to a thinning (faster growth) comes only from the competition FINN learnt on unthinned plots. The conformal interval is measured on the natural dynamics over one step; after a cut it is kept as is, which is another hypothesis.

The volume comes from the diameter only (FINN carries no height). On 12 974 trees of 1000 IFN plots of BFC, the tariffs of the exact species give 1.8 % more than the IFN volumes in total, 9.6 % less between 7.5 and 20 cm and 18.6 % more above 70 cm (data-raw/prototype_finn_volume.R). The carbon inherits this volume (stems below 7.5 cm carry none) and holds the same bef and fraction_carbone as C1, so that year 0 compares with C1.
